name: 55330 · Elk River, MN
findings: ZIP 55330 (Elk River) has 125 nonprofit organizations. 61 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 43 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 55330 (Elk River) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 55330 (Elk River) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 66% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 65 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
